text: The box shall play a household member's recording of a book when a card is put on it, and stop when the card is taken off.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: The household test: a thing they build together and then use every night.

text: The card watcher shall turn raw reader polls into card present, card gone and crowded.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: Presence is the play state (design D7), so this is the input every other behaviour depends on.

text: With a card left on the pad for one hour, the watcher shall report it gone zero times.
acceptance: T-CARD-HOLD passes: zero false gone events per simulated hour, seeds 1-5, on iid 25% misses and on every miss log recorded from a real pad. The invented bursty channel in proposals/modulo-debounce.mjs is reported, not passed: no rule meeting TAPE-CARD-LEAVE survives 2 s spells of 70% misses.
rationale: Measured: the current rule (3 consecutive misses) drops a card 340 times an hour on the simulator's own 25% flaky setting, and 96 times an hour on bursty misses. The simulator page says it holds. It does not.

text: The watcher shall report a removed card gone no later than 1.25 s after the last good read.
acceptance: T-CARD-LEAVE passes: 1000 scripted removals across seeds, maximum latency at most 1.25 s.
rationale: HOLD alone is met by never believing a card left. This leaf is the other side of the trade, so the debounce cannot be tuned in only one direction.

text: With two or more tags in the field, the box shall play nothing until one tag remains.
acceptance: T-CARD-CROWD passes: a second tag arriving during playback pauses within one poll, and audio resumes only once a single tag reads again.
rationale: Cards are a deck; a stack is the normal case, not the edge case.

text: The player shall follow the state machine on tape/firmware, written once as des processes.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: The firmware is a state machine; des is a state-machine engine with a clock.

text: A card with resume set shall restart within 1 s of where it was removed, and within 15 s of where it was after a power cut.
acceptance: T-FSM-RESUME passes over 1000 random sessions including removals, track ends, back and next presses, and power cuts.
rationale: Position is saved on removal and every 15 s (tape/firmware).

text: WiFi and audio output shall never both be on.
acceptance: T-FSM-RADIO passes: zero overlapping simulated milliseconds in 1000 random sessions; plus a negative control in which a mutant that raises WiFi on a false gone is caught.
rationale: This rule is why one 18650 gives about 20 h of stories (tape/firmware). A false gone raises WiFi mid-story, which is how TAPE-CARD-HOLD and the power budget are the same bug.

text: When the last track of a card ends with the card still on the pad, the box shall go silent and shall not repeat.
acceptance: T-FSM-FINISH passes.
rationale: Bedtime. No auto-repeat (tape/firmware FINISHED).

text: After 30 min with no card and no button, the box shall enter deep sleep.
acceptance: T-FSM-SLEEP passes, including a card arriving at 29 min 59 s resetting the timer.
rationale: Deep sleep is what makes the battery version last between charges.

text: Every input and every decision shall be logged separately, with non-finite values kept distinct from absent ones.
acceptance: T-FSM-LOG passes: a log containing NaN and a missing value round-trips and the two stay distinct (fi-5f90c6).
rationale: Sensing, deciding and acting are three hands; the log has to show which one did what.

text: Replaying a logged session's inputs through the model shall reproduce its decisions one for one.
acceptance: T-FSM-REPLAY passes on 1000 simulated sessions; on hardware, on every serial log captured from the box.
rationale: The firmware will be C on an ESP32-S3, not node. Replaying its serial logs through the model is the only conformance check we can have, so it is the seam.

text: The portable box shall play for at least 15 h on one charge of its 18650 cell.
acceptance: A-POWER passes: lib/power.js applied to state-occupancy times from 1000 simulated evenings gives at least 15 h of PLAYING; later confirmed by one timed discharge on the built box.
rationale: The design quotes about 20 h. Simulated occupancy, including false gones, tests the quote rather than repeating it.

text: The printed enclosure shall meet the five constraints listed on tape/hardware.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: Q6 is still open; the constraints are not.

text: The nest shall hold a 63 x 88 mm card over the antenna by geometry, with no conductive material between them.
acceptance: I-ENC-NEST: the CAD model's nest pocket clears the card by 0.5 to 1.5 mm per side and the bill of materials has no metal above the antenna.
rationale: Children are not careful; geometry is.

text: A card in the nest shall read through the printed lid on at least 99% of polls.
acceptance: D-ENC-RANGE: one hour of raw polls logged on the real lid at the chosen thickness and infill; miss rate at most 1%, and the log is added to the T-CARD-HOLD channels.
rationale: Lid thickness eats read range. This log is also the channel the debounce must be tuned on.

text: The speaker shall be sealed to its baffle with at least 200 cm3 of enclosed air behind it, not shared with the battery bay.
acceptance: A-ENC-SEAL: the CAD model's closed back volume is at least 200 cm3, computed from the model, not estimated.
rationale: A driver open at the back cancels its own bass (tape/hardware).

text: The grille holes shall each be under 4 mm across, with total open area at least 1257 mm2.
acceptance: A-ENC-GRILLE: hole sizes and summed area computed from the CAD model.
rationale: 1257 mm2 is the full 40 mm face; the true cone is smaller, so this errs open. Under 4 mm keeps fingers and crumbs off the cone.

text: At the volume pot's end stop, the box shall measure no more than 85 dB(A) at 50 cm.
acceptance: D-SAFE-VOL: pink noise at full volume, read on a sound meter checked against a reference, at most 85 dB(A) at 50 cm.
rationale: The end stop is the hearing-safety part. 85 dB(A) is my chosen ceiling, not a cited standard; EN 71-1 should be read before this number is trusted.

text: A household member's recording shall play from a card on the printed box, on the household's own shelf.
acceptance: D-HOUSE: one book recorded on a phone, bound to a card, and played through to FINISHED on the built box by someone who did not build it.
rationale: Nothing else earns the whole tree its value.

text: The box shall write a generation number into every bindings file it writes and into its flash mirror, and at boot shall restore from the mirror and log the restore when the bindings file carries a generation lower than the mirror's; a bindings file with no generation number shall decide.
acceptance: T-KEEP-STALE passes: in the des box model, an SD returned with an older box-written cards.json (half the bindings) leaves 0 of 200 eight-book decks scrambled, the parses-decides rule scrambles at least 1 of 200, and a hand-written {} with no generation number still clears the bindings.
rationale: A cards.json dragged back from an old laptop copy parses, so the parses rule lets it decide: 193/200 eight-book decks scrambled, mean 3.0 wrong cards (proposals/modulo-torn.mjs). Absent and torn files are closed by TAPE-KEEP-ABSENT with the parses wording; this closes the third route Morphyx named. In the merged tree it sits beside TAPE-KEEP-ABSENT under TAPE1-STORE.
